summary: The registrant, News Corp, filed a Form 8-K reporting routine disclosure of its ongoing stock repurchase program under which up to $1 billion of Class A and Class B common stock may be acquired. The filing is a procedural disclosure to the Australian Securities Exchange, not a special situation event. It contains forward-looking statements about possible future repurchases but no definitive offer, tender, or material corporate action that would qualify as a special situation. No terms, dates, or structural mechanics of a deal are presented. This is a standard current report of ordinary share buyback activity.
